title: Proposition 1.1.19 (Etale descent for smooth coalgebras)
statement_scope: Complete author statement of Proposition 1.1.19: the construction R -> cCAlg^sm_R, regarded as a functor from commutative rings to the 2-category of essentially small categories, satisfies descent for the etale topology. This is the whole selected result; the introductory Theorem 1.3.15 and the surrounding survey material are not counted.

difficulty_reason: H2 under author-work-bearing-core-v1-20261114: at original/Elliptic-II.pdf physical p.21, Proposition 1.1.19 is not a formal descent citation. Its proof block pp.21-23 constructs a sheaf of isomorphisms to Gamma^*(Prim) and uses a filtered torsor argument in Lemma 1.1.20 (pp.21-22), then handles arbitrary R by nilradical reduction and lifts smoothness across a nilpotent ideal via Ext vanishing and the universal property of Gamma^* in Lemma 1.1.21 (pp.22-23). These are concrete non-routine compatibility and lifting steps above routine qualifying-exam work.
